answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 21107 Country: India Title: I want to know that is this true that if somebody read kalma lailahaillalla 1 lac 25 thousand times dozakh is haraam on him ????? plz reply me Question: I want to know that is this true that if somebody read kalma lailahaillalla 1 lac 25 thousand times dozakh is haraam on him ????? plz reply me Answer ID: 21107 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 580/580/M=1431) We are not aware of any proof with said specified numbers; however the Zikr of لا اله الا الله is superior to all other forms of Zikr . There are countless virtues mentioned in hadith regarding it. Hadhrat Shaikh Zakaria ( رحمة الله عليه ) has written in Fazail Aamal, that Shaikh Abu Yazeed Qurtabi said: I heard that a person who reads لااله الا الله seventy thousand times, he shall get rid of hellfire." (Fazail Amal, 1/387) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
